text:
Nina: FYI Prospect 'AtlasBank' wants a concise POC acceptance + billing delta for reserved vs burst. They specifically care about p99 under sustained load.
Omar: understood. their ask: p95 <210ms, p99 <480ms at 210 QPS. i'd recommend we propose p95 <270ms and p99 <700ms to be realistic.
Vik: traffic mix i'll run: 68% short text-gen (~35 tokens), 22% long-gen (~160 tokens), 10% embeddings. k6 mix will mirror their client batching config (batch=5).
Nina: security checklist: IP allowlist for load agents, confirmation of KMS integration, and proof of SOC2. Legal needs a one-sentence KMS wording for the acceptance sheet.
Legal: we can provide copy: "Hosted: KMS connector supports customer-managed keys; Private: customer-controlled CMK." also confirm audit log retention 90 days default.
Omar: test config: prefix/KV cache ON, batch_size=5, prewarm 9m, pin model rwd-instruct-2.0 (non-quant).
Vik: proposed runbook:
- smoke: 6 QPS x 3m
- ramp: 6 -> 210 QPS over 11m
- steady: 210 QPS x 30m
- surge: 420 QPS x 90s x 2 (observe degradation paths)
Command for ops:
```
k6 run --vus 220 --duration 32m atlas_mix_v1.js
```
InfraBot: SOC2 and SLA doc uploaded to /shared/pocs/atlasbank/docs.txt :white_check_mark:
Omar: quick internal run on staging: p95=155ms p99=380ms @115 QPS with batch=5 on A100-equivalent. dev numbers, not production.
Nina: metrics to capture in final sheet: p50/p95/p99, success rate, tokens/sec, KV hit %, GPU util, 5xx count, model_version, avg token length.
Omar: pricing ballpark: reserved pool for 210 QPS ~= $19k/mo; burst cushion to 420 QPS amortized ~= +$3.8k/mo. caveat: final calc needs avg tokens and embedding ratio.
Vik: acceptance criteria to propose:
- sustain 210 QPS for 30 minutes with success rate >= 99.5%
- p95 < 270ms, p99 < 700ms
- no unexpected 5xx during steady window; documented failovers allowed
Nina: i'll draft the one-page acceptance + short pricing appendix and send to buyer. Legal: feel free to paste the KMS wording there.
Legal: pasted exact KMS sentence and audit retention line into the shared folder.
Vik: uploading k6 scripts and sample payloads to the POC bucket now, will post link when done.
Nina: once buyer returns CIDRs and signs test consent i'll book a 2hr window next Wed/Thu and tag ops. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
